# 3. Import Data

## 3.1 Import Aspatial Data

```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather.csv")
```

```{r}
head(weather)
```

```{r}
# 建立日期欄位
weather <- weather %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month, day))

```

```{r}
# 篩選某一個站點
paya <- weather %>% filter(station == "Paya Lebar")

# 畫平均氣溫時間序列圖
ggplot(paya, aes(x = date, y = mean_temperature_c)) +
  geom_line(color = "tomato") +
  labs(title = "Daily Mean Temperature - Paya Lebar (2024)",
       x = "Date", y = "Mean Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
write_csv(weather, "weather_clean.csv")

```

# 4. UI Design

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Load the cleaned weather data
weather <- read_csv("weather_clean.csv")

# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("📊 Singapore Weather Stations – Time Series Explorer"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("station", "Choose a station:", choices = unique(weather$station)),
      
      selectInput("variable", "Choose variable:", choices = c(
        "Daily Rainfall (mm)" = "daily_rainfall_total_mm",
        "Mean Temperature (°C)" = "mean_temperature_c",
        "Max Temperature (°C)" = "maximum_temperature_c",
        "Min Temperature (°C)" = "minimum_temperature_c",
        "Mean Wind Speed (km/h)" = "mean_wind_speed_km_h",
        "Max Wind Speed (km/h)" = "max_wind_speed_km_h"
      )),

      dateRangeInput("date_range", "Select Date Range:",
                     start = min(weather$date),
                     end = max(weather$date)),

      helpText("This dashboard displays daily weather data for each station in 2024.")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Time Series Plot", plotOutput("tsPlot")),
        tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summaryStats"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output) {

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    weather %>%
      filter(station == input$station,
             date >= input$date_range[1],
             date <= input$date_range[2])
  })

  output$tsPlot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = date, y = .data[[input$variable]])) +
      geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Daily", input$variable, "-", input$station),
        x = "Date", y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  })

  output$summaryStats <- renderPrint({
    summary(filtered_data()[[input$variable]])
  })
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


```

```{r}
# 載入套件
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)

# 讀取資料
# 假設測站經緯度資訊（範例隨機產生）
station_coords <- weather %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarize(lat = runif(1, 1.2, 1.5), lng = runif(1, 103.6, 104.0))

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Singapore Weather Storyboard"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Overview", tabName = "overview", icon = icon("dashboard")),
      menuItem("Explore", tabName = "explore", icon = icon("search")),
      menuItem("Data Table", tabName = "data", icon = icon("table"))
    )
  ),
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(

      # Overview Page
      tabItem(tabName = "overview",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Station Map", leafletOutput("map"), width = 6),
                box(title = "Summary Plot", plotlyOutput("overview_plot"), width = 6)
              )
      ),

      # Explore Page
      tabItem(tabName = "explore",
              fluidRow(
                box(selectInput("station", "Select Station:", choices = unique(weather$station)), width = 4),
                box(selectInput("variable", "Select Variable:",
                choices = c("daily_rainfall_total_mm",
                            "highest_30_min_rainfall_mm",
                            "highest_60_min_rainfall_mm",
                            "highest_120_min_rainfall_mm",
                            "mean_temperature_c",
                            "maximum_temperature_c",
                            "minimum_temperature_c",
                            "mean_wind_speed_km_h",
                            "max_wind_speed_km_h")), width = 4),
                box(dateRangeInput("daterange", "Select Date Range:",
                                   start = min(weather$date), end = max(weather$date)), width = 4)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Time Series Plot", plotlyOutput("ts_plot"), width = 12)
              ),
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Summary Stats", verbatimTextOutput("summary_stats"), width = 12)
              )
      ),

      # Data Table Page
      tabItem(tabName = "data",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Weather Data Table", DTOutput("table"), width = 12)
              )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    weather %>%
      filter(station == input$station,
             date >= input$daterange[1],
             date <= input$daterange[2])
  })

  output$overview_plot <- renderPlotly({
    temp_by_station <- weather %>%
      group_by(station) %>%
      summarize(mean_temp = mean(mean_temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE))

    station_with_coords <- left_join(temp_by_station, station_coords, by = "station")

    p <- ggplot(station_with_coords, aes(x = lng, y = lat,
                                         size = mean_temp, color = mean_temp,
                                         text = paste("Station:", station, "<br>Temp:", round(mean_temp, 1)))) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_color_viridis_c() +
      labs(title = "Average Temperature by Station (Spatial View)",
           x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
      theme_minimal()

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  output$ts_plot <- renderPlotly({
    data <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = .data[[input$variable]])) +
      geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
      labs(title = paste("Time Series of", input$variable), x = NULL, y = input$variable)

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y"))
  })

  output$summary_stats <- renderPrint({
    data <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(data) > 0)
    summary(data[[input$variable]])
  })

  output$table <- renderDT({
    filtered_data() %>%
      datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(data = station_coords) %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      addMarkers(~lng, ~lat, label = ~station)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
